$comment: The one source of the paid tiers. scripts/stripe-catalogue.mjs makes Stripe match this file and audits it; the tenant control plane reads the same limits. Amounts are in cents; a paid price is per seat (quantity = seats). Tiers approved 2026-09-22; the storage add-on (per 10 GB block, quantity = blocks) proposed the same day. secure_links_per_member is each member's own allowance of live secure links; the secure-links add-on (per 50-link pack, quantity = packs, team and business only, approved 2026-10-17) adds 50 links per pack to ONE pool the whole workspace shares (secure_links_pool). Storage grants cut to 2/5 GB per seat and the storage add-on, relay overage and document-appends prices re-derived from billing/rates.json on 2026-10-18 (docs/plans/billing-automation.md); every entry marked "derived": true is written by scripts/rates/update-rates.mjs and checked by billing/derive.test.mjs, never edited by hand.

addons.name: Citadel Workspace Extra Storage
addons.$comment: APPROVED 2026-09-22 at $2 per 10 GB block (1x DO SQLite cost). derived: true means billing/derive.mjs computes this price from rates.json x pricing-model.json (today: $6 while storage lives in DO SQLite) and the rates agent writes it here ONLY once pricing-model.json approval.status is approved; until then the proposal is reported, never written (docs/plans/billing-automation.md row 9).

metering.$comment: Approved 2026-09-23 (the owner asked for cost passed through plus a margin; docs/plans/tenant-quotas.md). Until the SDK RelayGate exists the metered quantity is every byte a tenant sends INTO its object (bytes_in): each relayed byte arrives once, and control traffic is small beside it. gb_bytes: a billed GB is 10^9 bytes. max_frame_bytes: one WebSocket message larger than this closes the socket (1009), to protect the 128 MB isolate. flush_seconds: how often an object with open sockets writes its counters to its own storage.

metered.$comment: APPROVED 2026-09-23 at 10 cents/GB (2x Cloudflare Realtime TURN). derived: true means billing/derive.mjs computes this price (today: 15 cents, TURN x 3) and the rates agent writes it here ONLY once pricing-model.json approval.status is approved (docs/plans/billing-automation.md row 7/decision 5).

metered.$comment: PROPOSED 2026-10-18, not sold: status proposed keeps it out of the Stripe catalogue, Checkout and the usage subscription until the owner approves (docs/plans/billing-automation.md decisions 2-4). A document append writes 3 DO rows over its life (update + log head, then the compaction delete) at $1.00/M rows plus 1/20 of a $0.15/M request: $3.01 per million. Per paid seat the plan includes document_appends_per_seat per period; beyond that, whole thousands are billed through a Stripe Billing Meter at this price x the multiplier, rounded up to the cent.
